apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Keys let CI pipelines and scripts call the FerroDock API with a limited role.

created.title: Key created
created.body: Copy it now. For your security it will not be shown again.

empty.title: No API keys
empty.description: Create a key to automate deployments from CI.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Theme and language apply to this browser.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Encrypted copies of the panel database and proxy routes, made daily and on demand. Restoring one also needs the master key.
backups.ownerOnly: Only the organization owner can manage panel backups.

empty.title: No backups yet
empty.description: A backup runs every day automatically. You can also start one now.

masterKey.title: Master key
masterKey.description: Backups and stored secrets are encrypted with this key. Keep a copy somewhere other than this server; without it a backup cannot be restored.
masterKey.revealed: Store this key in a password manager. Anyone with the key and a backup can read the panel data.

restore.title: Restore on a server
